city_vars.city_spotlight:
Lufkin sits at the heart of the Piney Woods, serving as the commercial anchor for Deep East Texas and the seat of Angelina County. The surrounding forests built the city's original economy, and timber and wood products manufacturing still run deep in its identity, though the modern base has broadened considerably. Lufkin Industries' oil field equipment work, alongside healthcare, education, retail, and government offices, now gives the local economy a sturdier, more diverse footing than its lumber-town roots alone.

With roughly 34,000 residents, Lufkin feels sized just right — big enough for full-service hospitals, a community college, and steady employers, yet small enough that neighborhoods like Crown Colony and Kurth still carry a distinct, close-knit character. It's a working city, proud of its piney landscape and its role as the region's steady hub.

ts_tabs.label: Gas Tank
ts_tabs.desc: Navien gas tank models rely on a burner and thermostat to maintain temperature. Common issues include sediment buildup reducing efficiency, failing thermostats causing temperature swings, and corrosion inside the tank. Local providers check burner operation, inspect the gas line and control valve, and flush sediment to restore performance.

ts_tabs.label: Electric Tank
ts_tabs.desc: Navien electric tank water heaters use heating elements to warm water. Upper and lower elements can fail independently, thermostats may malfunction, and mineral deposits accumulate over time in Texas water. Providers test element continuity, verify thermostat settings, and descale tanks to address buildup affecting heating speed.

ts_tabs.label: Gas Tankless
ts_tabs.desc: Navien tankless gas models heat water on demand through a heat exchanger. Scale buildup clogs the exchanger, gas control valves wear, and ignition systems misfire in hard-water regions. Providers descale the unit, test gas flow and ignition, check venting clearance, and inspect for flame issues causing cold-water surges.

ts_tabs.label: Electric Tankless
ts_tabs.desc: Navien electric tankless units use high-wattage heating elements for instant hot water. Element fouling and electrical connection corrosion are frequent failures. Providers descale elements, verify proper voltage supply, check inlet/outlet connections, and test flow sensors to restore consistent temperature delivery without delays.

columns.heading: No Hot Water
columns.text: Often caused by a faulty igniter, gas supply issue, or flow sensor malfunction in tankless models. The local provider you're connected with will diagnose whether the problem is ignition, fuel delivery, or sensor-related and perform the needed repair.

columns.heading: Water Temperature Fluctuates
columns.text: Mineral buildup in the heat exchanger or a failing temperature sensor can cause inconsistent heating. A local provider will inspect the unit, check for scaling, and adjust or replace the sensor to restore stable water temperature.

columns.heading: Leaking Water
columns.text: Leaks may stem from a cracked heat exchanger, loose connections, or a faulty relief valve. Contact a local provider immediately—water damage worsens quickly. They'll identify the leak source and repair or replace the affected component.

columns.heading: Strange Noises or Vibration
columns.text: Popping, rumbling, or rattling often signals mineral deposits in the tank or heat exchanger, or loose internal parts. A local provider can flush the unit, inspect for damage, and tighten or replace worn components to restore quiet operation.

columns.heading: Error Code or Warning Light
columns.text: Navien units display codes for ignition failure, gas supply problems, venting issues, or sensor faults. The provider you're matched with will read the code, run diagnostics, and repair the underlying cause—whether ignition, airflow, or electrical.

columns.heading: Takes Too Long to Heat
columns.text: Slow heating in tankless or tank models is often due to sediment or mineral buildup blocking water flow, or a weakened heating element. A local provider will flush the system and test heating components to restore fast, efficient hot water delivery.
